about.title: About SwipeDict & Legal
about.aboutText1: Welcome to SwipeDict! This app is designed to make vocabulary learning easier with an interactive swipe interface. Mark words as 'Keep' or 'Ignore' to track your learning progress. Use the detail view for examples, learning tips, and to add your own notes, images, or drawings. Happy learning!
about.aboutText2: For general discussions, questions, and community exchange, visit our
about.liabilityText1: The content of our dictionaries is created with the greatest care. However, the translations, example sentences, and explanations are generated with the help of artificial intelligence (AI).
about.liabilityText2: Please note that AI-generated content may contain inaccuracies or errors. We assume no liability for the correctness, completeness, and timeliness of the provided content. The use of the content is at your own risk.
about.liabilityText3: We are grateful for any reports of errors. Please use the feedback functions in the app ("Propose Correction" or "Propose New Word") to help us improve the data quality.
about.privacyText1: The protection of your personal data is very important to us. This app is designed to collect and process as little data as possible.
about.privacyDataScope: Type, Scope, and Purpose of Data Collection
about.privacyDataText1: SwipeDict is designed as a "client-side application." This means that all your personal data is stored exclusively locally on your device in your web browser's storage (using IndexedDB and LocalStorage). There is no transfer of your personal learning progress, notes, or media to our servers.
about.privacyDataText2: The data stored by the app in the browser includes:
privacyDataList: Your chosen username and preferred language setting.
Your learning progress (which words you have marked as 'Keep' or 'Ignore').
Your personal learning aids (text notes, audio recordings, images, drawings).
Your SRS (Spaced Repetition System) learning status.
SwipeDict has absolutely no interest in your personal data and therefore does not collect it.
Likewise, no Google tracking or advertising tracking takes place.
about.privacyDataText3: Communication with our server is limited to retrieving (downloading) public dictionary data (word lists, detailed information, official audio files). No personal data is transmitted from you to us in this process.
about.privacyDataText4: If you clear your local browser storage (cache, cookies, website data), all your data stored in the app will be removed. (Warning: This cannot be undone!)
about.privacyCookiesText: This app uses a single, technically necessary cookie named `swipedict_consent_given`. This cookie's sole purpose is to store your consent to the privacy notice so it is not displayed on every visit. No third-party tracking or analytics cookies are used.
about.privacyGoogleDriveText: If you use the optional Google Drive backup feature, you authenticate directly with Google via an OAuth2 window. SwipeDict only receives a temporary access token to create and read a single backup file in a **special, hidden application data folder** in your Google Drive. This folder is only visible to SwipeDict and does not appear in your normal Drive folder structure. We never have access to other files or folders in your Drive. Your password is never transmitted to us.
about.privacyFeedbackText: If you send us feedback, corrections, or word proposals via the app, the data you enter, along with your username, is transmitted to us via email to process and attribute your suggestion.
about.privacyRightsText: Since all your personal data is stored locally on your device, you have full control. You can permanently delete all your data at any time using the "Reset All Data" function in your profile. You have the right to free information about any data we may have stored about you (e.g., from feedback). For concerns regarding your data, please contact us at the address provided in the imprint. Please note that beyond the data received via the feedback function, we do not store any personal data about you that we could provide.
about.imprintResponsible: Responsible for content according to § 55 Abs. 2 RStV
